thread:
lina: Hi everyone  Lina here, joining as Product Designer (Growth). Quick onboarding checklist questions: 1) I can't find the canonical component tokens / design system file in Figma. 2) Where's the source of truth for roadmap vs delivery board (Notion/Jira)? 3) How do I get a staging prototype hosted so PMs can QA? Who should I ping for each?

aisha: welcome Lina! :tada: Component tokens live in the Platform UI kit in Figma. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/PLATTokens/platform-ui. If you get 403 ping @design-ops with the file url + work email.

kevin: hey Lina  i'm Kevin on design-ops. I can add you to the Platform UI team and give edit on the tokens. Also FYI we maintain a Tokens MD in Notion for cross-references: https://redwood.notion.site/Design-System-Tokens.

lina: thanks  I can see the file but can't duplicate components (button variants show locked). Is that permission or a library publish thing?

kevin: that's a library publish setting. i've given you "Can use" and flipped the library to allow duplications for Growth team members. Try duplicating now.
lina: works now, cheers.

aisha: roadmap vs delivery: roadmap lives in Notion (Product > Roadmap) for strategy/quarters. Delivery/implementation lives in Jira (project: PROD-GROWTH). We keep a tiny sync page that links sprint boards to roadmap items. Link: https://redwood.notion.site/Product-Roadmap.

lina: good to know. who owns the mapping between roadmap items and Jira tickets? want to follow the status for a couple experiments.

robbie: hey Lina  i'm the Growth PM. I own the roadmap <> delivery mapping for experiments. I'll add a column in the Roadmap doc with ticket links and set up a weekly triage sync. DM me the experiment names you'll track.

lina: will do. last one: staging prototypes. I built a clickable flow in Figma, want to host a stable share link for stakeholders to test on staging. How do we get a deploy link?

aisha: for lightweight tests we use Figma share links + the feature-flagged staging environment. For more integrated prototype tests (with backend data) file a Proto Deploy request: https://redwood.notion.site/Prototype-Deploys and tag @eng-platform. It usually takes 48 hours.

robbie: if it's just UI feedback, post Figma's "Share to anyone with link" and enable device frames, then drop in #prod-design-review. For PM/ENG QA on staging, use the Prototype Deploy request.
lina: OK i'll start with a shared Figma link then open a deploy request if we need staging data.

kevin: also FYI we run a weekly "Design Pair" hour where new designers can pair with engineers on implementing components (Thurs 11am PT). We'll add you to the invite.

design-ops-bot: Lina added to: Product Team, Design - Growth, Design System Access group. Onboarding checklist updated (Tasks: confirm tokens access, join design pair, read Research Playbook).

lina: amazing, thanks for the fast help everyone! I'll post the prototype link in #prod-design-review when it's ready.
